entries.german: Schreiben Friedrichs v. Rosenberg an den Würzburger Bischof betr. das ihm von Pfalz streitig gemachte Verleihungsrecht der Pfarrei Boxberg
entries.english: Letter from Friedrich von Rosenberg to the Bishop of Würzburg concerning the right of appointment to the parish of Boxberg, which the Palatinate disputes with him.
